value.rationale: Three equispaced atoms with one varying mass are a minimal naturally symmetric test of quantitative one-component geometry. Unlike qualitative connectedness, the exact every-threshold phase chart identifies an intermediate two-component regime iff a<1, its collapse at symmetry, and a sharp fractional 3/2 cusp with a nonzero coefficient. These facts are useful precise geometric benchmarks and not a renamed general component-count lemma.
